F.name: RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.empiricalFirstMoment
F.expanded_type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T η g : ℝ),
      0 < T →
        0 < η →
          0 < g →
            g < 1 / ↑k →
              ∃ (c : ℝ),
                0 < c ∧
                  ∃ (N0 : ℕ) (_ : 2 ≤ N0),
                    ∀ (N : ℕ),
                      N0 ≤ N →
                        ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n),
                          n ≤ N →
                            ∀ (a K : ℕ),
                              a < K →
                                ↑K ≤ T * Real.log ↑N →
                                  ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (K - a)),
                                    RiffleUpperV2.FirstColumnGood cuts ⋯ g →
                                      RiffleUpperV2.EmpiricalNegativeMargin N a cuts ⋯ η →
                                        RiffleUpperV2.expectedCommonEdges cuts ≤ ↑N ^ (-c)

E.name: RiffleUpperV2.EmpiricalUpper.empiricalUpper

  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T η0 g0 γ0 : ℝ),
      0 < T →
        0 < η0 →
          0 < g0 →
            0 < γ0 →
              ∃ (ρ0 : ℝ),
                0 < ρ0 ∧
                  ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
                    0 < ρ →
                      ρ ≤ ρ0 →
                        ∃ (c : ℝ),

                            ∃ (N0 : ℕ) (hN0 : 2 ≤ N0),

P.name: RiffleUpperV2.ProfileUpper.bufferedUpper
P.expanded_type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T η : ℝ),
      0 < T →
        0 < η →
          ∃ (χ0 : ℝ),
            0 < χ0 ∧
              ∀ (χ : ℝ),
                0 < χ →
                  χ ≤ χ0 →
                    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k),
                      P.IsRegular χ (RiffleUpperV2.regularityConstant k) →
                        ∀ (g γ : ℝ),
                          0 < g →
                            g < 1 / ↑k →
                              0 < γ →
                                ∃ (ρ0 : ℝ),
                                  0 < ρ0 ∧
                                    ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
                                      0 < ρ →
                                        ρ ≤ ρ0 →
                                          ∃ (φ0 : ℝ),
                                            0 < φ0 ∧
                                              ∀ (φ : ℝ),
                                                0 < φ →
                                                  φ ≤ φ0 →
                                                    ∀ (μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k),
                                                      RiffleUpperV2.ScalarIntegrable μ P T →
                                                        RiffleUpperV2.reducedMargin μ T ≤ -η →
                                                          ∀ (ε : ℝ),
                                                            0 < ε →
                                                              ∃ (N0 : ℕ) (hN0 : 2 ≤ N0),
                                                                ∀ (N : ℕ) (hN : N0 ≤ N)
                                                                  (cuts :
                                                                    RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N
                                                                      (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T)),
                                                                  TimeProfile.AlmostLike cuts ⋯ μ P T ρ φ →
                                                                    RiffleUpperV2.LocalGood cuts ⋯ g γ ρ 0 T →
                                                                      RiffleUpperV2.tv
                                                                          (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts)
                                                                          (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) ≤
                                                                        ε

T.name: RiffleUpperV2.ProfileUpper.criticalTimeUpper
T.expanded_type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k) (cuts : (N : ℕ) → RiffleUpperV2.InfiniteCuts k N),
      RiffleUpperV2.ArbitrarilyFineApproximation μ cuts →
        (∀ (t : ℝ),
            0 ≤ t →
              RiffleUpperV2.criticalTime μ < ENNReal.ofReal t →
                Filter.Tendsto
                  (fun (N : ℕ) =>
                    RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw ((cuts N).take (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N t)))
                      (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N))
                  Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
          ∀ (ε : ℝ),
            0 < ε →
              ε < 1 →
                Filter.limsup (fun (N : ℕ) => RiffleUpperV2.mixingTime (cuts N) ε / ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log ↑N))
                    Filter.atTop ≤
                  RiffleUpperV2.criticalTime μ

REmpiricalBound.name: RiffleUpperV2.ProfileUpper.randomEmpiricalBound
REmpiricalBound.expanded_type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T η0 g0 γ0 : ℝ),
      0 < T →
        0 < η0 →
          0 < g0 →
            0 < γ0 →

                  ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
                    0 < ρ →
                      ρ ≤ ρ0 →
                        ∃ (c : ℝ),
                          0 < c ∧
                            ∃ (N0 : ℕ) (hN0 : 2 ≤ N0),
